events.title: The World of Slime demo launches on August 26!
events.summary: Your first chance to touch the soft, squishyslimes! On August 26, set off into the soft and squishy World of Slime on Steam.A laid-back adventure to enjoy with your friends — get ready to download the PC demo. Add the game to your Steam wishlist and you'll get notified the moment the demo goes live.Show the World of Slime demo some love!From TEAM42

events.title: Dev. Note Vol.3
events.summary: Hey there, Adventurers!We are TEAM42, the devs behind the upcoming casual MMORPG, ‘World of Slime.’In our last Dev. Note, we introduced the Slimepedia, where every slime you meet gets recorded, and the Slime Knowledge that becomes real power on your journey.So what can you actually do with all those slimes logged in your Slimepedia?Today, we’re here to answer that! Let’s talk about Exploration with your slimes, and Slime Riding, which will carry you to places your own two feet could never reach.
